title: Bridging the Gap: Enhancing LLM Performance for Low-Resource African Languages with New Benchmarks, Fine-Tuning, and Cultural Adjustments

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating zero-shot and few-shot performance on multiple-choice reasoning and knowledge benchmarks (Winogrande, MMLU, Belebele) translated into 11 African languages, comparing accuracy against English baselines.

Using human annotators to label translated benchmark questions as culturally 'appropriate' or 'inappropriate' (strange, incoherent, or disrespectful in the target culture), and measuring the difference in model accuracy between these subsets.
